messages:
Alex R: Quick sync — draft proposal for observability work we should push into the next planning cycle. High level: ship Dashboards v1 + basic Tracing hooks + a Cost Breakdown widget. Defer deep Error Causal Analysis and full E2E request traces to Q3. Asking for quick alignment and launch criteria.

Alex R: Scope bullets:
1) Dashboards v1: per-route latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, token counts, cache hit rate, per-model breakdown. Filter by time + model + route.
2) Tracing hooks: SDK snippets to attach request_id, model_variant, route; emit minimal spans for model calls. Sample at 1% by default.
3) Cost widget: compute token-based cost, cache-adjusted cost, show 7/30/90d trends, export CSV.

Alex R: Proposed launch criteria:
- Cost calc accuracy within 5% vs billing for 7d sample
- Dashboard load < 1s for up to 30k rows
- Tracing samples available and queryable within 30s of ingest
- Beta customers (2) signed up and can validate per-route exports

Alex R: Customer asks surfaced: ACME wants per-route CSV exports + scheduled daily cost report; BetaShop asked for alerting on model quality regression (daily). Tradeoffs: tracing requires infra indexing and schema change. Dashboards are quick but need consistent event schema.

Maya K: +1 on this direction. CSV export for ACME is high priority. Can we make CSV an opt-in feature for early release? :+1:

Jordan (eng): Tracing SDK change is small (few lines), I'll paste a snippet below. Big chunk is storage/indexing cost and query perf. Estimate: infra 2w, storage config + retention work 1w, frontend 1w. We can reduce retention to 30d for per-route samples to cut cost.

Jordan (eng): ```js
// simple SDK hook idea
redwood.track({
  request_id: ctx.requestId,
  model: ctx.model,
  route: ctx.route,
  span_type: 'model_call'
})
```

Chris P: For launch criteria add: eval harness that compares cost calc to invoice (can be within 5%). I can own that. Also suggest a canary rollout to 2 customers for 2 weeks before GA.

Priya: Ops ask: alert thresholds must be editable per-customer. ACME will insist on different SLA thresholds. Also compliance asked for view audit logs on cost dashboards (who viewed/extracted CSV). Add to backlog.

deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry-schema-v2 -> staging :shipit:

Alex R: Responses/adjustments:
- Make CSV export a stretch target but enable opt-in beta for ACME if infra can prioritize it.
- Keep per-route history default to 30d.
- Tracing sample default 1% but expose toggle to increase for debugging.
- Launch plan: infra (2 sprints) -> SDK + frontend (1 sprint) -> canary with BetaShop + ACME -> GA after 2 weeks stable.

Maya K: Sounds reasonable. Approve for planning. :tada:

Jordan (eng): I'll open infra ticket (INF-4821) with the storage/cost estimate and retention options. I'll also add a feature flag for per-customer alert thresholds.

Chris P: Will prototype the eval harness and push a basic comparison script by EOD Friday.

Priya: Noted about audit logs — I'll file a compliance backlog item and link to this thread.

Alex R: Great. I'll update the roadmap doc (link in PRD) and add the launch criteria to the PRD. If anyone has blocker level concerns, please call them out here before EOD so we can adjust sprint planning. Thanks! :eyes:
